title: JMAP object URIs passed through federation resolve in wrong context
description: Pre-existing (predates object-uri move). draft-atwood-jmap-object-uri-00 makes a jmap: URI relative to the session/peer it was received from, but a server relaying a peer's Peer/deliver payload to its own clients passes the URI on unchanged; the client then resolves it against its own server (notFound, or a different object with the same ids). Federation draft never mentions jmap: URIs. Options: (a) receiving server strips MessageActions/fields whose uri is a jmap: object URI; (b) server rewrites/annotates with origin; (c) define rule in object-uri draft that relays must not pass jmap: URIs through unchanged and let carrying protocols choose. Affects object-uri, chat-federation, chat-tasks (line ~252 'receiving client adapts'), chat-calendars uri definitions. Found by verify workflow wf_e2550798-ffd.
close_reason: (c)+(a): object-uri relay MUST NOT; federation strips jmap: MessageActions/Endpoints from Peer/* data and peer Session (ownerEndpoints); link spans MUST NOT carry jmap: URIs; clients MUST NOT put jmap: URIs in encrypted content. Verified by skeptic; signatures/edits/push/MIMI unaffected.
